title: net2 r7e-k0.5 on net1 v5: test links, once
description: The one test-link run of the first learned net2 to pass its gate (exp-net2-gate-r7e05-133): round 7's three gate3 students at teacher gain 0.5 (exp-net2-r7-gate3-124, seeds 1 to 3) as one policy on their mean beliefs, with q vetoing the push (gate3_copies "rule"), p's threshold at 0.5 and q's at 0 (release model-net2-r7e05-cands, named seed 0). On validation it had +0.086 (+0.040 to +0.139) with Cubic from the start, +0.054 (+0.004 to +0.107) in the competition conditions, five-family mean +0.026, copies -0.005 (-0.064 to +0.049); it was chosen after about 17 gates on the same validation links, so this run is the check. It runs next to the fixed rule on net1 v5 (u = 0.25, release model-net1v5) and BBRv3 on the five test families (campaign seeds 13 and 31, as exp-final-test-100), the held-out competitors for 60 s, and 2 and 4 copies for 30 s. Reported: log utility against BBRv3 per family (experiments/rule_report.py), and per link the net2 minus the rule with 95% intervals (experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py, as at the gate).
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/m" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); P=(--policy "rule-v5=$IN/m/rule-u0.25.onnx"); for f in "$IN"/c/ppo-r7e-k0.5-s*.onnx; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$f" .onnx)=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" test 13 31 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60" --split test --family held-competitors --duration-ms 60000 --seed 31 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-held-competitors-60"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split test --duration-ms 30000 --seed 31 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart held-competitors-60 copies-30s && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-bbr3.md" && uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py "$OUT"
